entries.text: I would like to extend my thanks to everyone who\nmade this extraordinary tournament possible.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_01

entries.text: Each and every Trainer demonstrated beautifully\nthe bond they share with their Pokémon.\r\nI couldn’t take my eyes off any of the matches![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_02

entries.text: “Taking lessons from tradition—growing stronger\nand greater.”[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_03a

entries.text: “Leading the way into the future—while valuing\nour individuality.”[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_03b

entries.text: That is our motto at Naranja Academy... And the\ntournament truly lived up to our ideals![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_04a

entries.text: That is our motto at Uva Academy... And the\ntournament truly lived up to our ideals![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_04b

entries.text: Now, I’m aware my speeches tend to get a little,\nshall we say, overlong, so I’ll wrap it up there.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_05

entries.text: I now turn the floor over to our special guest,\nChairwoman Geeta.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_06

entries.text: The friendly rivalry of the Trainers... The cheering\nand encouragement from the crowd...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: common_2150_top_01

entries.text: I feel like these are the perfect ingredients for\nthe academy—[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: common_2150_top_02

entries.text: no, for the whole Paldea region to become more\nlively and energized![VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: common_2150_top_03

entries.text: It is clear that [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she strives to become better every\nday, even after reaching such an esteemed rank![VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: common_2150_top_05

entries.text: It is my sincere hope that all Paldea’s people will\nbe inspired not just by h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer but by every Trainer\r\ngathered here who aimed for new heights...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: common_2150_top_06

entries.text: and that the seeds for many more future\nChampions will be sown![VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: common_2150_top_07

entries.text: I eagerly await news of all your achievements![VAR 0x0114(0011)]
entries.label: common_2150_top_08

entries.text: Thank you, Chairwoman Geeta.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_07

entries.text: Now, alas, it is time for this wonderful tournament\nto come to an end...\c\nBUT![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_08

entries.text:
This event seems to me to be a wonderful way to
build rapport between faculty and students and
invigorate the wider community beyond our walls.\c
So...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_09

entries.text: I hereby declare that the Academy Ace\nTournament will not end as a one-time event\r\nand will continue to be held regularly![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_10

entries.text: Wooo! Awesome! Director Clavell, you’re the\nbest!
entries.label: common_2150_mobs_01

entries.text: Maybe I’ll join next time, too!
entries.label: common_2150_mobs_02

entries.text: Oh my gosh, YES! This is everything I wanted![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_2150_rival_01

entries.text: I do hope you’ll participate next time,\nMiss Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_11

entries.text: Absolutely! I wouldn’t miss it for anything![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_2150_rival_02

entries.text: Well, dear students and staff, that wraps up our\nvery first Academy Ace Tournament.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_12

entries.text: Thank you again for joining us here today, and I\nhope you’re all excited for the next one![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_2150_head_teacher_13

entries.text: Yaaay! Thank yooou!
